project: The Canonical Shelf — Structural Redesign Implementation
objective: Implement the structural redesign across the entire front end by building the design system described in the mockups (layered styles, complete theme contract roles, shared components), moving screens onto it, deleting legacy overrides, closing guards to zero, and expanding themes 2 through 8.
invariants: Protestant 66-book canon; Berean Standard Bible is the default text
Assess understanding and reasoning, never personal theological assent; agreement with the Statement of Faith is never a condition of use
The curriculum states its published LGBTQ-affirming position openly while presenting other readings accurately; never claim neutrality
Stable learner and activity IDs are inherited; never renumber or rename them
Single-document SPA: public/index.html is the only application document
The design-tokens and layout contracts are the visual authority; public/canonical-shelf.css consumes their generated output
Pastoral and crisis-adjacent content routes through the Theologian crisis policy
No streaks, public leaderboards, or peer comparison
architecturalRules: Build the design system the mockups describe, then move screens onto it
No override layers, no patching old markup to look new, no !important, no aliases
Colors appear only in theme.css; everything else uses role variables
Stacking uses --layer-* variables only (nav, edge-tabs, popups, dim-overlay, theologian)
Screen layer may not set colors, fonts, or radii
Old code is deleted once replacement passes, never left running underneath
Guard baseline strictly shrinks to zero; never grows
No user-facing content lost: all existing capabilities, explanations, notes, activities, and study tools are reorganized and modernized in presentation/layout, never cut or condensed

nodes.title: Shelf Home (Semantic Bookshelf & Header)
humanGates: Visual audit of walnut texture, Revelation lean, support blocks, iron bookends, and hover/focus states
nodes.exitCriteria: Bookshelf reflects confirmed final design: dark walnut planks with visible grain, 2 walnut support blocks under each shelf, no suspension rods, iron bookends, OT full, NT at 80% fill, Revelation leaning on Jude, book titles visible only on hover/focus, no decorative statues or lamps. Header displays two-line v1 title with confirmed intro beside it.

nodes.title: Study Topics, Review & Practice, and Profile
humanGates: UX review verifying complete independence of review vs practice, absence of streaks/leaderboards, and full-screen Profile navigation (account workflow, appearance selector, translation utility, study progress)
nodes.exitCriteria: Study Topics, Review & Practice, and Profile re-implemented on Rail and Panel primitives. Practice games render with GameTile; Review and Practice progress tracked separately without streaks or leaderboards. Profile presents a full-screen layout (/profile) containing: (1) Account creation & management workflow with Name and Email fields alongside passkey/recovery credentials; (2) Appearance / themes selector (8 themes, light/dark/system mode); (3) Translation upload and selection utility (defaulting to BSB, supporting custom translation uploads); (4) Personal study management (My Notes, Saved Passages, Learning Progress). Content preservation strictly enforced: zero user-facing content lost, all existing data, notes, and capabilities cleanly reorganized into the modern layout. Legacy topics-experience.js, practice-experience.js, and profile modal code removed.

nodes.title: Theologian Integration (Docked Desktop & Centered Phone)
humanGates: Theological review on real test prompts ensuring citation grounding and crisis compliance
nodes.exitCriteria: TheologianPanel renders docked in 452px right column on desktop and as a centered card on mobile over dim overlay. Right-edge folder tab hidden while open. Scripture cited open by default; suggested replies render inside message stream; composer includes removable passage chip. theologian-chat.css replaced; backend crisis paths intact. verify-product-contract.mjs updated.
